_readme: Resume state for the newsletter harvest (tools/upkeep-routine.md step 2).
Read this BEFORE a harvest pass; update `last_processed`/`count`/`updated` and COMMIT it after.
This file lives in the repo (not session memory) precisely so a CLOUD agent can clone, resume, and open a PR.
`react-brain lint` cross-checks each `count` against encyclopedia.yaml sources_digested — they must match.
Narrative harvest history (what each pass changed, process learnings) lives in tools/harvest-log/LEDGER.md — in-repo since 2026-08-07.

this-week-in-react.name: This Week in React
this-week-in-react.notes: issue pages fetch directly at /newsletter/{n} — BUT a 200 IS NOT PROOF OF PUBLICATION: cross-check the ARCHIVE listing at /newsletter or reject titles ending in ': ...' before treating an issue as live (the 2026-08-18 #294-stub precedent, full story in LEDGER). Archive still ends at #294 as of 2026-09-01 (Tue); #295 presumably lands Tue/Wed — probe next pass

react-status.name: React Status
react-status.notes: corroboration-heavy; headliners usually already held. #488 (2026-08-27) resumed after the skipped week of Aug 20; probed first this pass per the standing note — archive carries it

react-digest.name: React Digest
react-digest.notes: issues slug-titled by featured article; article/depth-driven — durable yield is usually one decision-guide reading. Archive moved: /digests 404s, use /newsletters or /newsletters.rss (newest-first, resolves the slug). Slug numbers are NOT sequential (2330 → 2335 → 2340 → 2344 → 2350 → 2355)

react-native-rewind.name: React Native Rewind
react-native-rewind.notes: slug-titled; each issue page carries an authoritative 'Issue #NN' label near the title — use THAT, not sequential guesswork, to resume. RSS at /newsletter-rss.xml (newest-first) now 307-redirects — curl -L; canonical host is www.thereactnativerewind.com. #54/#55 processed 2026-09-01: #54's enriched/markdown family was already fully held (EDITORS), #55 yielded the Expo first-party agent-docs keep

native-weekly.name: Native Weekly
native-weekly.notes: nativeweekly.com is a shell — use the beehiiv archive (slugs like /p/aug-28-2026-issue-19); author also authors rnsec (watch self-promotion); strongest beat = agentic dev tooling. Cadence tightened: #18 2026-08-14 → #19 2026-08-28 (fortnightly?). Release-roundup rows mostly duplicate the firsthand watch — the articles are where its keeps are (#19: stale-ShadowNodes reading + the Reanimated 4.6/Worklets 0.12 flip arrived via its release table)

react-weekly.name: React Weekly
react-weekly.notes: site + api.react-weekly.dev are JS-shell/auth-gated — harvest via rss.xml content:encoded (FULL bodies). Links inside are api.react-weekly.dev/track/click/<id> redirects: resolve each with `curl -L` before dispositioning. `harvest inventory`/`coverage` return 0 links on the issue URL, so the coverage gate cannot cover this source — the RSS-derived manifest is the record. RSS window = latest 20: a backlog >20 issues loses them permanently (issues 1-7 already unreachable). TanStack-heavy.
